subject: RFI: Air-gapped / On-prem Capability Questionnaire — Monolith Financial
messages:
From: Kelly Owens <kelly.owens@monolith.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: RFI — Private / Air-gapped Deployment Capabilities

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking our introductory call last week. Attached is Monolith's standard RFI (Monolith_RFI_Form.xlsx) focused on private deployment and air-gapped operating models. Our security and compliance team would like detailed answers to the following by EOD next Wednesday if possible:

- Can you detail the supported private deployment topologies (VPC-only, on-prem installer, fully air-gapped appliance)?
- KMS/HSM options and supported integrations (CloudHSM, Thales, Azure Key Vault, etc.)
- Process for network provisioning, approved ports, and recommended firewall rules; any sample network diagrams appreciated.
- Software supply chain details: SBOM, signing, and patching cadence.
- Data handling: what data leaves customer environment, telemetry, and opt-outs.
- Attestation: SOC 2 Type II, penetration testing cadence, vulnerability management SLAs.
- Maintenance windows, upgrade process for air-gapped installs, and rollback options.

If you can provide a redacted SOC 2 report and a high-level network diagram with your response that would be ideal. Also happy to do a 45-minute technical deep dive with your security/infra lead — are you available Tue or Wed next week?

Best,
Kelly Owens
Security Procurement, Monolith Financial

Attachment: Monolith_RFI_Form.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Kelly Owens <kelly.owens@monolith.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-15T11:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RFI — Private / Air-gapped Deployment Capabilities

Kelly,

Appreciate the clear list — thanks. I attached our initial RFI responses and a high-level network diagram for the three supported topologies (RFI_Redwood_Private_Deployment_Responses_v1.pdf; network_diagram_v1.png). High-level summary below, and happy to schedule a security deep-dive with Vivek and engineering.

Summary (short):
- Topologies: Hosted VPC (Redwood-managed), Dedicated VPC (customer VPC peering / private link), On-prem package (installer or container bundle), and Air-gapped appliance mode (installer + signed images, offline activation).
- KMS/HSM: We support customer-managed KMS integration (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault), CloudHSM for hosted variants, and can integrate with on-prem HSMs via PKCS#11 for fully air-gapped deployments.
- SBOM & Signing: We provide per-release SBOMs and signed artifacts; patch cadence is configurable for private customers — typically monthly critical patches, quarterly releases.
- Telemetry: Minimal operational telemetry for health; all telemetry is opt-out for private installs and fully disabled in air-gapped mode.
- Attestations: We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II and pen test summaries under NDA.
- Upgrades/Rollback: Offline patch bundle workflow for air-gapped installs with rollback artifacts; automated in Dedicated mode.

Next steps I propose:
1) Vivek or Rishi to own the security deep dive and confirm the SOC2 redaction schedule.
2) Share additional artifacts (SBOM, redacted SOC2) via secure Drive link / NDA.
3) Schedule a 45-minute call — Tue 11/18 10:00am PST works for our team.

I'll email follow-ups to coordinate owners internally.

Regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com

Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the diagram — that helps. A few clarifying questions before the call:

1) Can you confirm the PKCS#11-supported HSM vendors and whether the on-prem installer has HSM drivers packaged or requires customer-side installation?
2) For air-gapped installs, do you provide an HSM-backed offline activation token flow? How long are tokens valid?
3) We need your typical timeline: how long to onboard a medium-sized cluster (8 GPUs) on-prem including HW acceptance testing?
4) Please provide the redacted SOC 2 Type II report and any pen test summary you can share under NDA.

We are available Tue 11/18 at 11:00am PST for the technical call (Monolith security).

Best,
Kelly Owens
On behalf of Monolith Financial Security Team
